'''The Fallen Warrior''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a [[Endregaad Plague|viral outbreak]] spread among the inhabitants of Endregaad and the world was placed under quarantine by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The world's [[Human/Legends|Human]] residents blamed [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] for spreading the disease and many individuals of alien [[Species/Legends|species]] took shelter inside The Fallen Warrior, which was built like a bunker and provided them with good protection. Several weeks later, the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] traveled to the cantina in search of the [[Esral'sa'Nikto/Legends|Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Orgamon]].
